judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the list item '(Poscivil) Graduate Program in Civil Engineering' (link to /poscivil) in the header search field's suggestion dropdown (#search-list). Its text is English and neither it nor any ancestor has a lang attribute, so it inherits the page's lang='pt-BR'; the live page still has this entry, with no lang anywhere inside the list. The dropdown is hidden until a matching query is typed (for example 'civil' or 'pr'), but then the entry is shown and exposed, so it is content in that state. It is not a language-neutral proper name: it is an English translation of the program's name (its own page's heading is 'Programa de Pós-Graduação em Engenharia Civil (Poscivil)'), while the Understanding document describes proper names as names used across languages without translation. A pt-BR voice would mispronounce it, and marking it lang='en' (H58) is what 3.1.2 asks, so this is a real 3.1.2 failure.
